name: Sophia Parker: Hidden Desires
source:
You take the role of Sophia Parker, a happily married middle-aged woman and mother of a son and daughter. Due to her husband’s new job offer she just moved with her family from their sleepy, cold, small town to San Alejo, a hot megacity by the sea. And not only the city is bigger but also their new house and backyard.

Sophia is a high school teacher and former college lecturer. She comes from a wealthy academics family. In this new town she will be gradually confronted with many delicate situations, both familial and extra-familial, full of temptations and taboos, accompanied by the mother of all questions: what’s really right and what’s really wrong? An odyssey of emotions.

So, will she stay the good, faithful wife or will she fall into all the temptations and become a filthy whore soon?

[From Patreon]
translation:
你扮演索菲亚·帕克（Sophia Parker）的角色，她是一位婚姻幸福的中年妇女，也是一对儿子和女儿的母亲。由于丈夫的新工作机会，她刚刚和家人从沉睡、寒冷的小镇搬到了炎热的海滨大城市圣阿莱霍。不仅城市更大了，他们的新房子和后院也更大了。

索菲亚是一名高中教师和前大学讲师。她出身于一个富裕的学者家庭。在这个新的城镇里，她将逐渐面临许多微妙的处境，既有家庭的，也有家庭外的，充满诱惑和禁忌，并伴随着所有问题的根源：什么是真正的对，什么是真正的错？情感的奥德赛。

那么，她会继续做一个善良、忠诚的妻子，还是会陷入所有的诱惑，很快就会变成一个肮脏的妓女呢？

[来自帕特伦]
